item.text: I’ll inspect the test module and trace the behaviors it asserts, then call out any concrete issues.

[`test/orders.js`](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-2FuNoZ\test\orders.js) exports order helpers: total calculation, percentage discount application, average price calculation, and a formatted receipt string. Despite its location, it contains no tests.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` uses `i <= items.length`, so its final iteration reads `items[items.length]` (undefined) and throws on `.price`. It should use `i < items.length`. This currently breaks `calcTotal`, `averageItemPrice`, and `formatOrder` for every array, including an empty one.
- `averageItemPrice` divides the order total by the number of line items. If “item” means an individual unit, it should divide by total quantity instead. It also yields `NaN` for an empty list once `calcTotal` is fixed.
- There is no input validation for missing/malformed `items`, quantities, or prices; invalid input will produce exceptions or `NaN`.
